basic_profile.bio: Avid gamer and tech enthusiast from Toronto, Canada. I work as a software developer for a mid-sized tech firm specializing in cybersecurity solutions. My interests range from exploring socio-economic theories to diving deep into city-building games like Ostriv. I spend my weekdays mostly online in the evenings after work, and I'm single with a lot of time dedicated to gaming and online discussions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a Computer Science degree from the University of Waterloo, I have a strong foundation in software development and cybersecurity. My interest in socio-economic theories is largely self-taught, fueled by online courses and extensive reading.
